name: Folio
description: Privacy-conscious personal finance, budgeting, credit-card rewards, and benefit tracking PWA

paragraphs: Folio is a personal-finance and credit-card rewards tracker. The current foundation includes invite-only authentication, a responsive PWA shell, securely gated Plaid Sandbox/Production connectivity, connection repair and revocation, durable background synchronization, account and balance summaries, paginated transactions, user-reviewed categories, exact monthly budgets, a versioned card catalog, explainable reward estimates, reviewable benefit matches, normalized data export, and complete account deletion.

This repository is a recruiter-facing source snapshot of the private production project. It contains no production credentials, personal financial data, account identifiers, or private commit history. The deployed application remains invite-only because it connects to real financial accounts.

requirements.text: The Cards page requires the user to confirm a connected account's exact product before applying effective-dated reward rules, then estimates cash back or points only for posted transactions categorized as expenses and shows the estimate for each eligible purchase.
Folio never creates a user from its sign-in form.
